finding.trigger: Held job FD verified by bounded hash but not seal bits
finding.problem: A mutable regular job file can be altered after BINDCHILD; one hash does not guarantee the worker later consumes the same bytes
finding.required_evidence: Sealed immutable job bytes, independently verified at BINDCHILD and consumed by exact fixed worker; after-bind mutation/alias fault test
finding.resolution_observed: Controller now requires F_SEAL_SEAL|SHRINK|GROW|WRITE on held job FD in addition to size/hash
